ambient_events: The sealed hatch is cold to the touch and gives back nothing.
Air whistles thinly through a seam in the plating; there is space beyond, and it is large.
A hazard stencil on the bulkhead has been painted over, then painted over again.
description: A short dead spur ending at a heavy sealed bulkhead, its rivets sound and its wheel-lock welded fast. Whatever lies beyond it, a lower works or a flooded plant level or something the plant would rather stayed shut, is not opening today. The Watch have left it alone, and they leave very little alone. That should tell you something.
name: Sealed Sublevel
